# Compawss AI - Screenshots & Assets

This folder contains all screenshots and visual assets used in the main README.md file.

## Current Screenshots

### Required Screenshots:
1. **landing-page.png** - Landing page with orbital navigation system
2. **home-dashboard.png** - Home dashboard with emergency dispatch center

## How to Add Screenshots

1. Save your screenshots in this folder (`.github/assets/`)
2. Use descriptive filenames (e.g., `landing-page.png`, `home-dashboard.png`)
3. Recommended image format: PNG or JPG
4. Recommended resolution: 1920x1080 or higher
5. Compress images to keep file size under 1MB each

## Image Naming Convention

- Use lowercase with hyphens: `feature-name.png`
- Be descriptive: `injury-analysis-screen.png` instead of `screen1.png`
- Include version if needed: `dashboard-v2.png`

## Usage in README

Images are referenced in the main README.md using relative paths:
```markdown
![Alt Text](.github/assets/image-name.png)
```

## File Organization

```
.github/assets/
├── README.md (this file)
├── landing-page.png
├── home-dashboard.png
└── (future screenshots)
